'''Rudolf Podgornik''' (27 August 1955 – 28 December 2024) was a Slovenian [[theoretical physicist]].

Podgornik was an emeritus professor at the [[University of Ljubljana]], and at the time of his death held a chair professorship at [[University of Chinese Academy of Sciences]]. He is best known for his work on [[soft matter physics]], physics of [[Coulomb]]ic fluids, physics of  [[macromolecule|macromolecular]] [[Chemical reaction|interactions]], [[Lifshitz]] theory of Casimir–van der Waals dispersion interaction, the [[Casimir effect]], and [[biophysics]], including the physics of [[cell membrane|membranes]], [[polymers]], [[polyelectrolytes]], [[DNA]], [[RNA]],and [[virus]]es.

==Life and career==
Podgornik was born on 27 August 1955.<ref>{{cite web |title=Rudolf Podgornik Curriculum Vitae |url=http://www-f1.ijs.si/~rudi/IJS_SITE/CURVIT.html}}</ref> He and his coworkers discovered the line hexatic phase in the phase diagram of the concentrated long fragment DNA solutions.<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Podgornik |first1=R |last2=Strey |first2=H H |last3=Gawrisch |first3=K |last4=Rau |first4=D C |last5=Rupprecht |first5=A |last6=Parsegian |first6=V A |date=1996-04-30 |title=Bond orientational order, molecular motion, and free energy of high-density DNA mesophases. |journal=Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences |volume=93 |issue=9 |pages=4261–4266 |doi=10.1073/pnas.93.9.4261 |pmid=8633052 |doi-access=free |pmc=39523 |arxiv=chem-ph/9508004 |bibcode=1996PNAS...93.4261P }}</ref> The line hexatic mesophase appears to be the preferred packing form of long DNA in bacteriophages. He is the author of more than two hundred scientific papers<ref>{{Cite web |title=Rudolf PODGORNIK {{!}} Chair Professor {{!}} Ph.D. {{!}} Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing {{!}} CAS {{!}} School of Physical Sciences |url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Rudolf_Podgornik |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201102045822/https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Rudolf_Podgornik |archive-date=2020-11-02 |access-date=2025-07-13 |website=ResearchGate |language=en}}</ref> and a coeditor of books: "Electrostatic Effects in Soft Matter"<ref>{{cite book |editor-first1=Christian |editor-first2=Patrick |editor-first3=Rudolf |editor-last1=Holm |editor-last2=Kékicheff |editor-last3=Podgornik |title=Electrostatic Effects in Soft Matter and Biophysics |date=2001 |doi=10.1007/978-94-010-0577-7 |isbn=978-1-4020-0197-0 |url=https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-94-010-0577-7  |language=en}}</ref> (Proceedings of the NATO Advanced Study Institute, Les Houches, France, 1–13 October 2000, Series: NATO Science Series II: Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry, Vol. 46 ), together with Christian Holm and Patrick Kekicheff and "Electrostatics of Soft and Disordered Matter"<ref>{{Cite web |title=Electrostatics of Soft and Disordered Matter |url=https://www.routledge.com/Electrostatics-of-Soft-and-Disordered-Matter/Dean-Dobnikar-Naji-Podgornik/p/book/9789814411851 |access-date=2025-07-13 |website=Routledge & CRC Press |language=en}}</ref> (Pan Stanford Publishing, March 31, 2014) with 
David S. Dean, Jure Dobnikar and Ali Naji. Together with D. Harries, J. DeRouchey, H. H. Strey, and V. A. Parsegian, he coauthored the chapter "Interactions in Macromolecular  Complexes Used as Nonviral Vectors for Gene Delivery", in the leading textbook of gene therapy: "Gene Therapy: Therapeutic Mechanisms and Strategies",<ref>{{Cite web |title=Gene and Cell Therapy: Therapeutic Mechanisms and Strategies, Third Edition |url=https://www.crcpress.com/Gene-and-Cell-Therapy-Therapeutic-Mechanisms-and-Strategies-Third-Edition/Smyth-Templeton/9780849387685 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304063717/https://www.crcpress.com/Gene-and-Cell-Therapy-Therapeutic-Mechanisms-and-Strategies-Third-Edition/Smyth-Templeton/9780849387685 |archive-date=2016-03-04 |access-date=2025-07-13 |website=CRC Press |language=en}}</ref> N. Smyth – Templeton, Marcel Dekker, New York (2008), Third Edition.

Rudolf Podgornik was [[Professor emeritus]] at the Physics Department,<ref>{{Cite web |title=prof. Rudolf Podgornik |url=https://www.fmf.uni-lj.si/~podgornik/FMF_SITE/Domacastran.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220119004550/https://www.fmf.uni-lj.si/~podgornik/FMF_SITE/Domacastran.html |archive-date=2022-01-19 |access-date=2025-07-13 |website=www.fmf.uni-lj.si |language=en}}</ref> Faculty of Mathematics and Physics, [[University of Ljubljana]]. In the past he was professor of physics at the Physics Department,<ref>{{Cite web |title=prof. Rudolf Podgornik |url=https://users.fmf.uni-lj.si/podgornik/FMF_SITE/Domacastran.html |access-date=2025-07-13 |website=users.fmf.uni-lj.si}}</ref> Faculty of Mathematics and Physics, [[University of Ljubljana]] and professor of biophysics at the [http://www.mf.uni-lj.si School of medicine],  [[University of Ljubljana]]. He was also Chair professor at the School of Physical Sciences, [[University of Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (UCAS), Beijing and adjunct professor at the [[Kavli Institute for Theoretical Sciences]] (KITS) at the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing and at the [[Wenzhou Institute of the UCAS]] (WIUCAS). He was the former head of the research program [[Biophysics]] of [[polymers]], membranes, gels, [[colloids]] and [[cell (biology)|cells]], financially supported by the Slovenian Research and Innovation Agency (ARIS)  and a Scientist emeritus at the Theoretical Physics Department of the Jozef Stefan Institute in Ljubljana.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Rudi Podgornik Research Page |url=http://www-f1.ijs.si/~rudi/IJS_SITE/HomePage.html |access-date=2025-07-13 |website=www-f1.ijs.si |language=en}}</ref> Until 2010 he was an Adjunct researcher at the [[National Institutes of Health]], Bethesda, MD.  From 2011 to 2016 he was also adjunct professor at the [http://www.physics.umass.edu Physics Department], University of Massachusetts, Amherst and from 2013 to 2017 an adjunct professor at the Materials Science & Engineering Department at the Case Western Reserve University, Cleveland.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-10-17 |title=Faculty and Staff Directory {{!}} Case School of Engineering {{!}} School of Engineering {{!}} Case Western Reserve University |url=https://case.edu/engineering/about/faculty-and-staff-directory |access-date=2025-07-13 |website=case.edu |language=en}}</ref> He was a former coeditor-in-chief of the [https://www.springer.com/physics/biophysics+%26+biological+physics/journal/10867 Journal of Biological Physics], published by Springer, a former member of the Editorial board of the journal [[Physical Review E]]  published by the [[American Physical Society]] and of the journal [http://www.nature.com/srep Scientific Reports]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Editors {{!}} Scientific Reports |url=https://www.nature.com/srep/about/editors |access-date=2025-07-13 |website=www.nature.com |language=en}}</ref> published by Nature-Springer and a former Advisory Editor of the European Biophysics Journal (EBJ) published by Springer Nature on behalf of the European Biophysical Societies Association (EBSA). He spent several terms as a panel member of the '[https://erc.europa.eu/apply-grant/starting-grant Starting grants panel] of the '[https://erc.europa.eu/homepage European Research Council]' established by the '[https://ec.europa.eu/info/index_en European commission]'.

Podgornik died on 28 December 2024, at the age of 69.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://ias.tau.ac.il/rudolph_podgornik_2024_Passing |publisher=Institute of Advanced Studies, [[Tel Aviv University]]|title=IAS mourns the passing of Distinguished Guest Professor Rudolf Podgornik}}</ref>

==Awards==
In 1986-1989 he was awarded the '[https://www.fic.nih.gov/Programs Fogarty fellowship]'''<nowiki/>'<nowiki/>''', at the Laboratory of Structural Biology, Division of Computer Research and Technology, '[https://www.nih.gov National Institutes of Health, Bethesda]'''<nowiki/>'<nowiki/>'''. In 1992 he received a postdoctoral fellowship of the ''[https://www.vr.se/inenglish.4.12fff4451215cbd83e4800015152.html Swedish Research Council]'' at Physical Chemistry 2 of the  '[https://www.kemicentrum.lu.se/english/ Chemical Center (Kemicentrum) at Lund University]'''<nowiki/>'<nowiki/>'''.  In 1995 he was the recipient of the  ''Division of computer research and technology Director's award'' for "recognition and appreciation of special achievement" ('[https://www.nih.gov National Institutes of Health, Bethesda]'''<nowiki/>'<nowiki/>'''). In 1999 he was the recipient of the ''[http://www.mizs.gov.si/si/delovna_podrocja/direktorat_za_znanost/sektor_za_znanost/dejavnost/nagrade_in_priznanja_za_izjemne_dosezke_v_znanstveno_raziskovalni_in_razvojni_dejavnosti/zois_awards/. Zois Award]'', which is the highest prize for scientific excellence in Slovenia [http://www.arhiv.mvzt.gov.si/si/delovna_podrocja/znanost_in_tehnologija/dejavnost/nagrade_in_priznanja_za_izjemne_dosezke_v_znanstveno_raziskovalni_in_razvojni_dejavnosti/1999/]. In 2002 he was awarded the '[https://www.cnrs.fr/en/research CNRS Chercheur Associe]'''<nowiki/>'<nowiki/>''' fellowship at the '[https://www.lps.u-psud.fr/en/home-english/ Laboratoire de Physique des Solides - UMR 8502 Universite Paris Sud 11]'''<nowiki/>'<nowiki/>'''. In 2008 he was a co-recipient of the ''[https://www.inceusa.org/about-ince-usa/honors-and-awards/hbpa/ Martin Hirschorn IAC Prize]'', made possible by the generosity of Martin Hirschorn, given once every two years and funded by the INCE Foundation.  In 2015 he was awarded the ''[https://www.espci.fr/en/international/visiting-professors-and/joliot-chair Joliot chair]'' fellowship of the '[https://www.espci.psl.eu/en/ Ecole supérieure de physique et de chimie industrielles de la ville de Paris (ESPCI)]'''<nowiki/>'<nowiki/>'''. In 2016-2017 he was awarded the ''[http://www.tau.ac.il/institutes/advanced/fellows.html Sackler Scholar award]'' and became a '[https://ias.tau.ac.il/Nirit_Michael_Shaoul_Fund Nirit and Michael Shaoul Fellow]', within the framework of the ''[https://ias.tau.ac.il Mortimer and Raymond Sackler Institute of Advanced Studies, Tel Aviv University, Israel]'''<nowiki/>'<nowiki/>'''. ''From 2017 to 2019 he became a '''Foreign expert''' in the [http://www.1000plan.org/en/foreign.html 1000 talents] program of the Chinese government at the [http://english.ucas.ac.cn University of Chinese Academy of Sciences] in Beijing. In 2020 he received the Key project grant of the'' '[https://www.nsfc.gov.cn/english/site_1/index.html National natural science foundation of China]'''<nowiki/>'<nowiki/>'''.''
